title: Dromaius novaehollandiae Lue0043 03
author: Lütgens, Hans
changes: Female emu (Dromaius novaehollandiae) drumming: a rolling series of deep booms made with her inflatable throat pouch, recorded at the Ruhr Zoo in Germany in 1984. Trimmed to 15.50–17.96 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. From the Animal Sound Archive (Tierstimmenarchiv) of the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble and 50 Hz mains hum between the booms.
